				trigger_if = {
					limit = { has_variable = zg361_p3_portfolio_cycle }
					NOT = { var:zg361_p3_portfolio_cycle = root.var:zg361_review_serial }
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }

				trigger_else = { always = yes }

# Internal domain entry. Call in assessed-subject scope with ROOT = frozen manager.
zg361_p3_aa_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_aa_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		zg361_p3_initialize_portfolio_effect = yes
		zg361_p3_aa_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_aa_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aa_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_cycle value = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aa_case value = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_p3_aa_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_p3_aa_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.229 } }
		}
	}
}

# Internal domain entry. Call in assessed-subject scope with ROOT = frozen manager.
zg361_p3_aj_launch_effect = {
	remove_variable = zg361_p3_runtime_applied
	zg361_case_aj_open_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = zg361_case_kernel_applied var:zg361_case_kernel_applied = 1 }

		zg361_p3_aj_initialize_effect = yes
		var:zg361_case_aj_owner = { save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aj_owner }
		save_scope_as = zg361_p3_aj_subject
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aj_cycle value = var:zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = zg361_p3_aj_case value = var:zg361_case_aj_case_serial }
		if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = yes zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			zg361_p3_aj_run_authorized_ai_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { is_ai = no zg361_is_celestial_liege_trigger = yes } }
			scope:zg361_p3_aj_owner = { trigger_event = { id = zg361p3.334 } }
		}
	}
}

# #229 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m229_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_metric_dictionary_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m229_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m229_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m229_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m229_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m229_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m229_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m229_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m229_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m229_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m229_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_metric_dictionary_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m229_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m229_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aa_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #232 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m232_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_backfill_policy
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m232_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m232_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m232_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m232_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m232_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m232_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m232_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m232_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m232_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m232_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_backfill_policy }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m232_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m232_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aa_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #233 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m233_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_write_state

				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m233_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m233_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m233_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m233_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m233_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_cycle

						has_variable = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m233_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m233_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m233_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m233_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m233_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_subject }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m233_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m233_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aa_visible_revision add = 1 }

# #234 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.

	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_write_case

				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject

				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m234_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m234_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m234_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m234_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m234_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m234_consumed_cycle

					var:zg361_p3_m234_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m234_write_subject

					var:zg361_p3_m234_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m234_write_state
					}
				}

			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }

# #235 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m235_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_guardrail_split
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m235_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m235_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m235_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m235_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m235_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m235_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m235_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m235_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m235_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m235_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_guardrail_split }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m235_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m235_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aa_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #236 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m236_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_scoring_curve
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m236_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m236_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m236_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m236_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m236_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m236_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m236_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m236_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m236_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m236_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_scoring_curve }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m236_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m236_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aa_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #239 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m239_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_write_case

				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_subject

				has_variable = zg361_case_aa_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m239_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aa_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m239_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aa_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m239_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aa_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m239_write_case = var:zg361_case_aa_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m239_write_state = var:zg361_case_aa_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_consumed_owner

						has_variable = zg361_p3_m239_consumed_cycle

					NOT = {

					var:zg361_p3_m239_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m239_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m239_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m239_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m239_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m239_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m239_write_subject }

# #302 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.

				}
			var:zg361_p3_m302_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m302_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m302_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m302_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m302_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state

					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m302_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m302_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m302_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m302_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m302_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m302_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m302_write_subject }

				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m303_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m303_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m303_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial

					var:zg361_p3_m303_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m303_write_state
					}
				}

			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m303_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m303_write_owner }

# #304 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m304_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_dual_parent_weights
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m304_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m304_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m304_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m304_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m304_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m304_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m304_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m304_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m304_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m304_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_dual_parent_weights }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m304_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m304_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #305 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.

	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m305_write_state

				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m305_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m305_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m305_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m305_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m305_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state

					var:zg361_p3_m305_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m305_write_state

# #308 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m308_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_hc_mix
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m308_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m308_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m308_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m308_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m308_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m308_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m308_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m308_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m308_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m308_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_hc_mix }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m308_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m308_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #309 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.

	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {

				has_variable = zg361_p3_m309_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m309_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m309_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m309_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m309_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m309_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state

					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m309_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m309_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m309_write_subject }

# #310 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.

	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_write_subject

				has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_legacy_rating_map
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m310_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m310_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m310_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m310_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m310_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_cycle

						has_variable = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_state

					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m310_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m310_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m310_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m310_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m310_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m310_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m310_write_subject }

		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}

# #311 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m311_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_pivot_policy
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_ag_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m311_write_owner = var:zg361_case_ag_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m311_write_subject = var:zg361_case_ag_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m311_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_ag_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m311_write_case = var:zg361_case_ag_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m311_write_state = var:zg361_case_ag_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m311_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m311_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m311_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m311_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m311_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_pivot_policy }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m311_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m311_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_ag_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #334 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m334_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_demand_source
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m334_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aj_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m334_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aj_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m334_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m334_write_case = var:zg361_case_aj_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m334_write_state = var:zg361_case_aj_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m334_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m334_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m334_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m334_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m334_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_case }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_consumed_state value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_state }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_visible_value value = var:zg361_p3_demand_source }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m334_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m334_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aj_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}

# #335 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m335_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_emergency_route
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m335_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aj_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m335_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aj_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m335_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m335_write_case = var:zg361_case_aj_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m335_write_state = var:zg361_case_aj_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m335_consumed_owner

					var:zg361_p3_m335_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m335_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m335_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m335_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m335_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m335_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m335_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m335_write_case

					}
				}

# #341 read-side consumer; existence gates precede every tuple read.
zg361_p3_m341_consume_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_write_owner
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_write_subject
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_write_cycle
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_write_case
				has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_write_state
				has_variable = zg361_p3_carryover_route
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_owner
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_subject
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_case_serial
				has_variable = zg361_case_aj_state
				}
			var:zg361_p3_m341_write_owner = var:zg361_case_aj_owner
			var:zg361_p3_m341_write_subject = var:zg361_case_aj_subject
			var:zg361_p3_m341_write_cycle = var:zg361_case_aj_cycle_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m341_write_case = var:zg361_case_aj_case_serial
			var:zg361_p3_m341_write_state = var:zg361_case_aj_state
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_owner
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_subject
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_cycle
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_case
						has_variable = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_state
					}
					NOT = {
					var:zg361_p3_m341_consumed_owner = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_owner
					var:zg361_p3_m341_consumed_subject = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_subject
					var:zg361_p3_m341_consumed_cycle = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_cycle
					var:zg361_p3_m341_consumed_case = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_case
					var:zg361_p3_m341_consumed_state = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_state
					}
				}
				trigger_else = { always = yes }
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_owner value = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_owner }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_subject value = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_subject }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_cycle value = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_cycle }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_consumed_case value = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_case }

		set_variable = { name = zg361_p3_m341_visible_provenance_case value = var:zg361_p3_m341_write_case }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_p3_aj_visible_revision add = 1 }
	}
}
